caption:
Navigating buzz around market listings requires caution and reliable information. Understanding the difference between regulated and unregulated markets is key to protecting your capital. These premiums exist outside of official oversight, meaning your money lacks the standard protections found in legitimate exchanges. Always prioritize regulated channels for your financial decisions. Context: SEBI. Have you ever wondered how official market listings actually work?
